digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP integration / Serena symbol tools
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before use, whereas Bash and other tools are loaded at session start, creating friction asymmetry that favors cheaper tools regardless of documentation
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only lever controlling tool deferral, is all-or-nothing (no per-tool or per-server granularity), and is configurable only via .claude/settings.json env block

Disabling tool deferral via ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false loads all connected MCP servers' schemas upfront at a measured floor cost of ~25k tokens for Serena alone and ~64k tokens on a typical multi-server setup
The original AC to limit always-loaded tools to <=4 Serena navigation tools is not implementable because ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH lacks per-tool selectivity
A tracked .claude/settings.json with appropriate .gitignore negation can ship the deferral setting as configuration-only, with one-line revert capability and documented trade-offs
